# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is described as round-faced, smiling, and good-natured.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy and quiet, to the extent that he uses a proxy to propose marriage. He is a hard-working, dependable young man with good sense and no bad habits.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

## History

Billy Andrews grew up in Avonlea alongside his sister Jane and other local youth. After his father deeded him the upper farm, he sought to get married. Due to his extreme shyness, he enlisted his sister Jane to propose to Anne Shirley on his behalf during a winter visit, offering to wait until she finished college if necessary. Following Anne's refusal, he turned his affections to Nettie Blewett, whom he eventually married. The couple later made a proud public appearance together at church in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
